people.name: Herod
people.line: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.

translations.web: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
translations.bsb: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
translations.kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
translations.asv: Then Herod privily called the Wise-men, and learned of them exactly what time the star appeared.
